entry.author: nzpost
entry.summary:
Understand the upcoming New Zealand Border Clearance Levies coming into effect on 1 April 2026 in this expert led session with NZ Post and New Zealand Customs.

In this video, we break down what the new government mandated levies mean for international shipments entering or leaving New Zealand. You’ll hear directly from New Zealand Customs as they explain why these changes are being introduced, who they apply to, and how they will affect businesses sending or receiving goods across the border.

We also address key questions submitted by NZ Post customers, providing practical insights to help you prepare for the transition.

For more information, resources, or support, visit www.nzpost.co.nz/border-levy
